Hi Tarik,

I would suggest the following reading: Bornovalova, M. A., Choate, A. M., Fatimah, H., Petersen, K. J., & Wiernik, B. M. (2020). Appropriate use of bifactor analysis in psychopathology research: Appreciating benefits and limitations. Biological psychiatry, 88(1), 18-27.

It discusses what different patterns of factor loadings mean in bifactor analysis. I think Figure 1 (B) from the article is close to what you have.

Hope this help!
Best,
Jošt
